source_verification: All crates and tools/simulation are clean at the measured source revision; all build and run products use target-1252. No changed expectation was set from native output.

previous_acceptance.result: Before the consolidated review: 65/65 benchmark cases faster. Superseded by the repaired source and acceptance below.

review_repairs.review: One fresh-context Astra xhigh review; seven findings repaired together, no re-review.
review_repairs.demonstration: All 19 new Python regressions fail at 4386bdf614 and pass after the repair. Native literal-degree decoding fails before/passes after; its offset expected values come from the CASA direction_identity fixture. The explicit CASA interoperability case passes.
findings: Publish same-table sibling keywords before consuming a writable list on close.
Use tabular referenceFreq/frame and preserve independent minFreq/maxFreq; match thrown type errors.
Retain frequency offsets in getspectrum and Spectral_Record, clear them on non-tabular Stokes spectrum setters, including the refused PLP mutation.
Decode native direction quantity units, including nested offsets.
Publish only the backing table before reads/writes/locks; metadata-only ok calls retain pending/clean locks.
Sort and select by persistent underlying row identity, remapping it through remove/recover/append.
Use the casacore half-chord separation formula for sub-milliarcsecond sorting.

environment_repairs: Embedded Rust Python initially lacked NumPy on sys.path; setting PYTHONPATH to the isolated venv site-packages made all 60 binding tests pass without a code change.
The CASA interop test uses getcomponent frequency converted to Hz; CASA getfreqvalue is a documented placeholder returning zero.
